summary_1line: Duryodhana resolves to die by fasting but is secretly summoned by Danavas who encourage him with prophecies of victory and the destruction of the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: A strange goddess rises from a sacrificial fire while Danavas perform rites in the netherworld and command her to bring Duryodhana.
Duryodhana sits on kusa grass in rags, silent and fasting, while his brothers and allies plead around him in anguish.
In the subterranean realm, hosts of delighted Danavas surround and embrace the bewildered Duryodhana they have magically summoned.
